subtopic: Checking Investment Professional Licenses and Backgrounds
source_evidence: Investor.gov has a free and simple search tool that allows you to find out if an investment professional is licensed and registered, and if they have a disciplinary history or customer complaints.
answer: Before considering an investment opportunity, check the background of the person promoting it. Investor.gov offers a free search tool to check whether an investment professional is licensed and registered, and to see whether they have a disciplinary history or customer complaints. This is a useful first step before evaluating the opportunity itself.
